Check specified output files alignment with latest runs

Source: R/check.R
check_output_files.Rd

Validates that the specified output files were generated from the most recent run that should have produced them. Ensures output files are current and haven't been modified since generation.

Usage

check_output_files(output_files, store = default_store())

Arguments

output_files

Character vector. Paths to output files to validate.

store

Character scalar. The run store directory (see default_store()). Defaults to default_store(). Nothing is written to it.

Value

A data frame with columns:

  • file_path (character): Full path to the output file

  • file_name (character): File name (basename)

  • run_id (character): Most recently submitted run that recorded this file (NA if not found)

  • run_submitted_at (POSIXct): When the generating run was submitted

  • run_completed_at (POSIXct): When the generating run completed

  • recorded_timestamp (POSIXct): File timestamp when recorded in the store

  • recorded_sha256 (character): SHA-256 checksum when recorded

  • current_timestamp (POSIXct): Current file modification time

  • current_sha256 (character): Current SHA-256 checksum

  • timestamp_changed (logical): Whether modification time changed since recording

  • checksum_changed (logical): Whether file content changed since recording

  • file_exists (logical): Whether file still exists

  • predates_submission (logical): Whether file predates the run submission

  • recorded_late (logical): Whether the run's completion was recorded late

  • status (character): Summary status: "missing", "no_run_record", "incomplete_run", "predates_run", "modified", "timestamp_changed", "suspect", "unchanged_late" or "unchanged" (see check_output_file_status())
